<span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">record</span> UserCreatedData(
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> o,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> arr,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> empty,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> nul,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> str,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> dupKeys
) {

    <span class="hl-comment">@SuppressWarnings</span>(<span class="hl-str">&quot;unchecked&quot;</span>)
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> UserCreatedData fromMap(<span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; map) {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> UserCreatedData(
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;o&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;arr&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;empty&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;nul&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;str&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;dupKeys&quot;</span>)
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; toMap() {
        <span class="hl-kw">var</span> map = <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-type">LinkedHashMap</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt;();
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;o&quot;</span>, o);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;arr&quot;</span>, arr);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;empty&quot;</span>, empty);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;nul&quot;</span>, nul);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;str&quot;</span>, str);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;dupKeys&quot;</span>, dupKeys);
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> map;
    }
